name: whisper-medium-arabic-codeswitched
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-medium (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of openai/whisper-medium, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.764 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-15. CAVEAT: evaluation slice is a held-out split of the same corpus the model was trained on, so the gain is in-domain adaptation rather than zero-shot transfer; the 17.9% headline and the 21.4% trainer-validation number also use different beam/VAD settings.

benchmarks.name: WER, asr_codeswitched_dataset held-out 1% test slice
benchmarks.config: Card table '| Model | WER |': openai/whisper-medium (base) 52.4% vs this model 17.9% (absolute reduction 34.5 points). jiwer WER, light normalisation (lowercase, diacritic+punct strip, no MSA folding), test_size=0.01 seed=42. CAVEAT: the test slice is a held-out split of the same corpus used for fine-tuning (34.1h, ~45k clips), so this is in-domain adaptation, not zero-shot transfer. Card also reports 21.4% on the trainer validation split (step 4000) with a different beam/VAD config.
